## Notes

Capacities from body parts: consciousness below 30% keeps a pawn from waking; moving below 15% incapacitates; each arm gives half of manipulation; blood pumping or digestion at 0% is fatal; poor tending raises scarring and infection risk; bionic leg +12.5% moving; base healing 8 damage per day.
